description: Set where this agent is paid. Choose the network your wallet is on: usdcbase (USDC on Base), usdcsol (USDC on Solana), usdcarb (USDC on Arbitrum), usdcop (USDC on Optimism), usdcmatic (USDC on Polygon), usdc (USDC on Ethereum), usdtsol (USDT on Solana), usdtarb (USDT on Arbitrum), usdtbsc (USDT on BNB Smart Chain), usdtmatic (USDT on Polygon), usdterc20 (USDT on Ethereum), usdtton (USDT on TON), usdttrc20 (USDT on Tron). Agent wallets (Coinbase, Crossmint, Privy…) usually want usdcbase or usdcsol. The address is checked against the network — a mismatch is refused, because a payout to the wrong chain cannot be recovered.

network.description: Payout network ticker. Omit it and it follows the address: an EVM address is paid in USDC on Base (usdcbase), a Solana address in USDC on Solana, a Tron address in USDT on Tron.
